integrity: A complete analytic proof and standalone elementary checker are included. Computational examples corroborate but do not prove the quantified theorem. Novelty has a nonexhaustive literature-priority risk, especially an inaccessible 2011 related article. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the homogeneous quadratic field on one nonsingular embedded algebraic torus; nonstationary periodic orbits and Euclidean two-dimensional surface area only. Total-variation scaling is a critical one-sided limit, not a general perturbation statement.
title: Two periodic annuli born at a sharp quadratic-torus threshold, with a surviving weighted area and arcsine latitude law
